extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media outlets, and press professionals seeking Recording Academy/GRAMMY assets
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for requesting, using, and licensing media assets (logos, press photos, archival footage, event photographs) from the Recording Academy and its affiliates, including required credit lines and contact points for licensing and questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media assets access request / form
rubrics_metrics.description: Please fill out the following form to receive access to a variety of assets including logos and press photos for the Recording Academy, GRAMMY Awards, GRAMMY Museum, and MusiCares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the provided form to gain download access to available assets. For questions regarding use of assets, contact communications@recordingacademy.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo credit attribution requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: When utilizing any of the photos available for download, please use the following credit: Courtesy of the Recording Academy® / Getty Images ©
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always include the exact credit line when publishing or broadcasting downloaded photos to comply with Recording Academy/Getty Images usage requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for asset-usage questions
rubrics_metrics.description: For questions regarding use of assets, please contact communications@recordingacademy.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this email for clarifications about permitted use, attribution, or any uncertainties about the assets obtained via the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media inquiries routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Please direct all media inquiries to: Recording Academy communications department communications@recordingacademy.com 310.392.3777
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All press/media requests should be sent to the Recording Academy communications department via the provided email/phone; do not contact other offices for general media requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archival footage usage restriction and licensing
rubrics_metrics.description: GRAMMY Awards Archival Footage (Available for Broadcast Only). Featuring over 40 years of fantastic GRAMMY Awards footage, including presentations, acceptance speeches, and performances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Archival footage is available for broadcast use only; for rates and licensing information contact Recording Academy (Paul Madeira) at 310.392.3777 to arrange licensing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event photographs sourcing / official photo agency
rubrics_metrics.description: If you need photographs from any Recording Academy event, please contact the Academy's official photo agency: Getty Images (Josh Norton 323.202.4144).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Event photos are handled by Getty Images — contact the named agency representative for event-specific photos, licensing, and usage permissions.
